## What Is an APi Group Internship?


An APi Group internship is a paid, onsite placement at one of 36 subsidiary companies under APi Group Corporation (NYSE: APG), a Fortune 500 safety and specialty services leader with $7.9 billion in annual revenue and approximately 29,000 employees worldwide. Unlike centralized corporate intern programs, each subsidiary, from fire protection firms like WSFP and Delta Fire to construction companies like Creamer and United Piping, hires independently through its own applicant tracking system. Interns work on real engineering, construction, and business projects, from sprinkler system design to project cost tracking. Glassdoor rates the company 3.7 out of 5 overall, with 66% of reviewers recommending it to a friend, and the interview process is rated positive by 85.7% of candidates. APi Group was certified as a Great Place to Work in 2025 and celebrated its 100th anniversary in 2026.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


Requirements vary by subsidiary and track, but several lines repeat across the six intern postings reviewed:


• **Enrollment:** actively enrolled in a relevant degree program. Engineering tracks look for construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering. Fire protection design requires coursework in fire protection engineering or a related field. Corporate roles accept business, finance, or accounting majors.


• **Drug test and background check:** required at most subsidiaries. Postings from WSFP, Creamer, and United Piping explicitly mention pre-employment drug screening and background verification.


• **Driver's license:** required for field engineering and trades roles that involve travel to active construction sites. Some postings also require reliable personal transportation.


• **Work authorization:** most subsidiaries use inquiry-based language about authorization to work in the United States. Requirements vary by subsidiary, so check each posting individually.


### Does APi Group Have a GPA Cutoff for Interns?


No published GPA requirement appears in any of the six APi Group subsidiary intern postings reviewed. Job descriptions emphasize enrollment in a relevant degree program, relevant coursework, and hands-on skills like AutoCAD or MS Office proficiency rather than a grade threshold. This is consistent with the construction and safety-services industry, where practical skills and certifications carry more weight than academic scores. That said, corporate finance and accounting roles at the parent company are more likely to weigh GPA informally.


## What Skills Does APi Group Look For, and How Do You Build Them?


Read across six APi Group subsidiary intern job descriptions, spanning Project Engineering, Fire Protection Design, Trades, Corporate Finance, and Accounts Payable, and one pattern dominates: MS Office and Excel proficiency appears in five of six, as do written communication and organizational skills. The difference between tracks shows up in the specialized requirements: AutoCAD for fire protection design, construction knowledge for field engineering, and safety compliance for trades and mechanical roles. Unlike tech companies that test coding skills, APi Group's subsidiaries evaluate practical readiness: whether you can manage a project timeline, communicate with a field team, and follow safety protocols on an active site.

## What Is the APi Group Application and Interview Process Like?


APi Group's hiring funnel is decentralized, so the process varies by subsidiary, but the general pattern across postings looks like this:


1. **Browse the aggregator page at[apigroupinc.com/careers/open-positions](https://www.apigroupinc.com/careers/open-positions) .** This is the only centralized listing across all 36 subsidiaries. Filter for internship roles and identify which subsidiary and track match your background.


2. **Apply through the subsidiary's own ATS.** APi Group uses three different applicant tracking systems (OurCareerPages, TalentHub, and Oracle Cloud HCM) across its subsidiaries, so you will land on a different portal depending on the role. Submit your resume and any requested materials directly.


3. **Set LinkedIn job alerts for specific subsidiary names.** Because there is no unified alert system, set separate alerts for 'WSFP intern,' 'Creamer intern,' 'United Piping intern,' and 'APi Group intern' to catch new postings as they appear.


4. **Complete pre-employment screening.** Most subsidiaries require a drug test and background check. Some field roles require a valid driver's license and may include a physical abilities assessment.


5. **Interview with the hiring manager.** The interview is straightforward: Glassdoor rates difficulty at 2.43 out of 5, and 85.7% of candidates report a positive experience. Expect questions about relevant skills, motivation for the specific subsidiary, and willingness to work onsite.


The two skills to drill are specificity and subsidiary research. APi Group's interview difficulty is low and overwhelmingly positive, so know the subsidiary, know the track, and bring evidence that you can handle the work from day one.

## How Do You Stand Out When 36 Subsidiaries Hire Independently?


Three moves, all calibrated for a decentralized hiring system. First, check the aggregator page at apigroupinc.com/careers/open-positions every week: no unified job-alert system exists across the 36 subsidiaries, so manual monitoring is the only reliable method. Second, name the specific subsidiary you want to join in your cover letter and explain why: saying 'I want to intern at WSFP because I am pursuing fire protection engineering' signals research depth that a generic 'APi Group' application does not. Third, bring credentials that match the track: OSHA 10 for field roles, AutoCAD proficiency for fire protection design, or a CPA-track transcript for accounting. The interview difficulty is low (Glassdoor 2.43 out of 5) and overwhelmingly positive (85.7%), so specificity and preparation, not polish, are what separate candidates.

## FAQ


### When do APi Group internship applications open for summer 2027?


APi Group accepts intern applications on a rolling basis year-round, with no single opening date. Each of the 36 subsidiaries posts independently through its own applicant tracking system. Summer 2027 postings typically appear starting in fall 2026 and continue through spring 2027. Check the aggregator page at apigroupinc.com/careers/open-positions weekly for new listings.


### How much does an APi Group internship pay?


Hourly rates range from $15.50 to $23, depending on the subsidiary and role. Engineering and project management positions at subsidiaries like United Piping pay $19 to $23 per hour. Some subsidiaries offer additional benefits: United Piping provides a housing stipend, health insurance, and 401k eligibility for interns working 24 or more hours per week.


### Does APi Group require a minimum GPA for interns?


No published GPA cutoff exists across APi Group subsidiaries. Job descriptions focus on enrollment in a relevant degree program rather than a specific grade threshold. Strong academic performance still strengthens your application, especially for corporate finance and accounting roles at the parent company where analytical skills are weighted more heavily.


### What is the APi Group internship interview process like?


Most APi Group subsidiary interviews are straightforward and conversational. Glassdoor rates the difficulty at 2.43 out of 5, with 85.7% of candidates reporting a positive experience. The typical process includes an application through the subsidiary's ATS, a phone screen with a hiring manager, and one in-person or video interview focused on relevant skills and motivation.


### Do APi Group interns get return offers?


Some subsidiaries explicitly offer post-graduation positions to strong interns. WSFP, for example, mentions a potential job offer at the end of the internship for a post-graduate role. No company-wide conversion rate is published, but APi Group's Leadership Development Program serves as the primary full-time pipeline for early-career hires coming out of intern roles.


### Is the APi Group internship remote or in-person?


All APi Group internships are fully onsite. Positions are located across sites in New Brighton, Minnesota; Hackensack, New Jersey; Yorkville, Illinois; Duluth, Minnesota; Phoenix, Arizona; and Centennial, Colorado. Field engineering and trades roles require a valid driver's license and may involve travel to active project sites within the subsidiary's operating region.


### Does APi Group sponsor visas for interns?


APi Group's internship postings use inquiry-based language about work authorization rather than outright prohibiting sponsorship. Most subsidiaries require candidates to be authorized to work in the United States. Check the specific subsidiary's posting for exact requirements, as policies can vary across the 36 operating companies under the APi Group umbrella.


### How do I find all APi Group internship openings in one place?


Use the aggregator page at apigroupinc.com/careers/open-positions, which lists roles across all 36 subsidiaries in one place. APi Group's internships are posted through three separate applicant tracking systems, so checking individual subsidiary career pages would mean searching dozens of sites. The aggregator is the only centralized listing available.
